text: Velvera offers a flexible, enterprise-ready Corporate Booking Plan designed for organizations seeking tailored procurement, deployment, and management of Velvera products at scale. The plan emphasizes customizability, volume-based benefits, and dedicated support to align with diverse corporate needs.

- Feature: Bulk Device Booking | Description: Order smartphones, tablets, wearables, and accessories in customizable bundles
- Feature: Dedicated Account Manager | Description: Single point-of-contact for all business queries and escalation
- Feature: Custom Device Configuration | Description: Pre-load corporate apps, Wi-Fi credentials, device policies, and asset tags before dispatch
- Feature: Flexible Delivery Scheduling | Description: Staggered or consolidated shipments according to business milestones or regional rollouts
- Feature: Priority Support & SLAs | Description: Priority resolution timelines, 24/7 remote tech support, and site visit scheduling on request
- Feature: Device Lifecycle Management | Description: Advance-replacement service, warranty & accidental damage upgrade options
- Feature: Enterprise Dashboard Access | Description: Real-time tracking of order progress, device inventory, and service tickets
- Feature: Flexible Payment Options | Description: Credit terms up to 60 days, staged payments, and consolidated invoicing
- Feature: E-waste & Upgrade Programs | Description: Reverse logistics for retired devices, discounted upgrade paths for existing fleet
